activities.specific_competence: 4.1 Identify opportunities created by literary works
activities.learning_activity: (b) Identify various opportunities depicted in a selected literary text
suggested_methods: Think-Pair-Share: Guide students through sharing various opportunities (e.g. business, employment, education, fishing and agriculture) in the society

Scaffold reading: Guide students through identifying opportunities in a selected literary text using the four scaffold reading stages (setting the scene, assigning tasks, asking questions and giving feedback)
activities.assessment_criteria: Various opportunities depicted in a selected literary text are clearly identified

activities.specific_competence: 4.1 Identify opportunities created by literary works
activities.learning_activity: (c) Design, write, revise, and edit a script for stage performance
suggested_methods: Project: Guide students in manageable groups through developing and presenting a script for performance
Discussion: Guide students in manageable groups through discussing the steps for developing a script for stage performance
activities.assessment_criteria: Script for stage performance is well designed, written and edited

activities.specific_competence: 4.1 Identify opportunities created by literary works
activities.learning_activity: (d) Adapt an episode or extract from a selected literary text on the stage
suggested_methods: Dramatisation: Guide students in manageable groups through staging an episode/extract from a selected literary text
activities.assessment_criteria: Episode or extract from a selected literary text is well adapted on stage

activities.specific_competence: 4.2 Compose original literary works
activities.learning_activity: (a) Develop a plan for composing a novel (idea, plot, setting and characterisation)
suggested_methods: Graphic organiser: Guide students in manageable group through making a plan for composing a novel
activities.assessment_criteria: A plan for composing a novel is well developed
suggested_resources: ICT tools

activities.specific_competence: 4.2 Compose original literary works
activities.learning_activity: (b) Apply basic skills in creative writing to compose a novel
suggested_methods: Independent composition: Guide students through composing a novel
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic skills in creative writing are correctly applied to compose a novel

activities.specific_competence: 4.2 Compose original literary works
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use ICT tools and digital platforms to write and publish a novel
suggested_methods: Project: Engage individual students in applying ICT knowledge and writing skills to compose a novel
Publishing: Guide individual students through publishing their novels on available platforms
activities.assessment_criteria: ICT tools and digital platforms are correctly used to write and publish a novel
